import numpy as np

# Perform bootstrapping to validate the most frequently used documentation format
def bootstrap_most_used(df, col, n_bootstrap=1000):
    bootstrap_results = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        sample = df[col].sample(frac=1, replace=True)
        bootstrap_mode = sample.mode().iloc[0]
        bootstrap_results.append(bootstrap_mode)
    return pd.Series(bootstrap_results).mode().iloc[0]

# Apply bootstrapping to each documentation column
bootstrap_results = {}
for col in documentation_columns:
    bootstrap_results[col] = bootstrap_most_used(df, col)

bootstrap_results
